method: Local read-only parsing of one downloaded actual CI artifact plus fixed previous inputs; no re-scan/download/install/build. Upstream aliases unioned symmetrically/transitively; RHSA references not counted as CVEs.

probe.scope: Fixed offline dependency behavior; real Langflow Flow remains separate.

before_after.comparison_limit: Same PyPI package/version facts on two AMD64 CI runs; query times and environments differ. Do not turn total image counts or initial local ARM64 comparison into a controlled vulnerability reduction percentage.

rhel_supplement.unit: RHSA advisory IDs, not CVE count

limits: Package matches are potential impact, not exploitability proof.
OSV snapshot date not exposed; no-match does not prove absolute safety.
LF primary RPM mapping_unknown is resolved only via its same-image RHEL supplement.
